text: South Africa's 2026 local elections, in numbers.
asr: South Africa's 2026 local elections, in numbers.

text: Nationally, the ANC fell from forty-five point six percent to thirty point eight. The DA rose to twenty-four point six.
asr: Nationally, the ANC fell from 45.6% to 30.8%. The DA rose to 24.6%.

text: The MK Party took nine point eight percent in its first local election. The EFF fell to six point two, and ActionSA rose to five point seven.
asr: The MK Party took 9.8% in its first local election. The EFF fell to 6.2%, and ActionSA rose to 5.7%.

text: Turnout climbed to fifty-two percent. Almost fifteen million people voted.
asr: Turnout climbed to 52%. Almost 15 million people voted.

text: But the biggest number is this. One hundred and thirty-seven of two hundred and thirteen councils are hung.
asr: But the biggest number is this. 137 of 213 councils are hung.

text: In the metros, only Cape Town has one party with a majority. The other seven need coalitions.
And those coalitions will set your rates, water and electricity tariffs from July twenty twenty-seven.
asr: And those coalitions will set your rates, water and electricity tariffs from July 2027.

text: Mmzahnsee Money Matters. Know who sets your rates.
asr: Mzansi Money Matters. Know who sets your rates.
